title: In Eclipse Jetty, the JSON parsing utilities provided by artifact jetty-util-ajax are vulnerable to StackOverflowError…
description: Eclipse Jetty's JSON parsing utilities in the jetty-util-ajax artifact are vulnerable to a StackOverflowError when processing inputs with deeply recursive structures. This vulnerability can cause denial of service by crashing the affected application. The issue is identified as CVE-2026-95533 with a high severity score of 8.2. No affected versions or patches are specified in the available data.
